lessons.title: Understanding Table Relationships 💍
lessons.description: Learn about primary and foreign keys, and how tables connect in a relational database.

lessons.title: INNER JOIN: Matching Rows Across Tables 🤝
lessons.description: Combine rows from two tables when they share a common key using INNER JOIN.

lessons.title: LEFT and RIGHT JOINs: Keeping All Records 🧾
lessons.description: Retain all rows from one table even if there’s no match in the other with LEFT/RIGHT JOIN.

lessons.title: FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and Self‑Joins 🔄
lessons.description: Explore the remaining join types and how to join a table to itself.

lessons.title: Joining Multiple Tables 🧩
lessons.description: Chain JOINs to query from three or more tables in a single statement.

lessons.title: Aggregations Across Joined Tables 📊
lessons.description: Combine JOINs with GROUP BY, HAVING, and conditional aggregates to answer complex questions.
